subject: Iridescent (Director) -> Prismatic: ROUTED (owner-directed) — keyword-graph teacher-user-story capture: discovery note in educator-end-users + vocabulary-bridge fold into the position-anchored plan, one docs PR; 2b pre-position unchanged
body:
Routing (owner-directed ~11:59Z, this supersedes the "hold for 177 merge" gate for THIS task only — the 2b pre-position stands unchanged, still gated on PR 177's merge): author the keyword-graph teacher-user-story capture, BOTH halves, as ONE small pure-diff docs PR off origin/main.

OWNER DIRECTION (verbatim intent): capture the keyword-graph teacher user stories for prioritisation as a small discovery note in the educator-end-users collection, AND fold the vocabulary-bridge story into the position-anchored plan's future cycles. Rationale: "it's hard to evaluate something if there is not user impetus to engage with it."

SUBSTANCE TO CARRY (Director analysis, owner-discussed this session; the note captures these as named considerations for prioritisation — decisions stay with the owner, research-outputs-name-not-make-decisions):

1. Explicit vocabulary planning: teacher preparing a unit/lesson gets the frequency-ranked, description-carrying bounded term set as the pre-teach artefact (tier-2/3 vocabulary instruction).
2. Vocabulary continuity across units: keyword->lesson edges + firstYear trace where a term was first met — "activate prior knowledge through familiar language"; pairs with get-prior-knowledge-graph (prerequisites = what was taught; keywords = what was named).
3. Position-anchored vocabulary bridge: at "my class just finished X — what next", surface shared terms (continuity) and new terms (pre-teach list) between the finished unit and candidate next units. THIS is the half that folds into position-anchored-teaching-continuity.plan.md as a future cycle.
4. Adaptation for EAL/SEND: bounded ranked terms with canonical Oak descriptions as raw material for simplification/glossary generation — agent never invents definitions.
5. Misconception adjacency (speculative, flag as such): keyword->lesson->misconception traversal surfacing terms whose lessons carry recorded misconceptions — test against real use before believing it.

Frame throughout: ADR-194 teacher-as-expert (tools inform, never decide); value proven by release and observed use — the tool is live on the prod alpha; these stories are hypotheses awaiting user impetus, which is the owner's stated reason for capturing them now.

SHAPE:
- Discovery note: a small note in the educator-end-users collection (follow the collection's README conventions for placement/naming; cite the owner direction 2026-06-11 and the re-proof report's G4b adjacency finding for grounding). Name the prioritisation decision as owner-owned.
- Plan fold: ADDITIVE future-cycle entry in position-anchored-teaching-continuity.plan.md carrying story 3 — owner-directed 2026-06-11, explicitly NOT blocking w2-c1. COORDINATE: Smouldering's claim 45b3a187 covers the w1-c1 registration surfaces, and they are mid monitor-to-merge on PR 178 — check the live registry at compose time, claim only the plan file + the new note path, and post your claim before editing.
- One commit, full gates, pure diff, PR off origin/main; merge ask to me at both-loops-settled.

SEQUENCING: this task now; queue item 2b (multiplicity dedup) remains pre-positioned and becomes available at PR 177's merge — finish this docs PR first, then 2b.

Grounding pointers: re-proof report at 968aff597 (.agent/reports/eef-revalidation-report-2026-06-11.md, §3 keyword adjacency); graph plan g4 todo (tool shape); PR 173 (the landed tool); PR 178 (the in-flight continue-teaching prompt whose plan you are folding into).
